The tour category tabs' active tab (.categories-tour .categories-tour-inner li.active a, /index.php/listings/categories/france) is the template's literal white on its accent fill (var(--color-primary)): Moxie 2.26 (template's white on its orange 2.86); its words take accent-on: 4.52 (Voiceflow) to 21 under the fifteen, Moxie 9.28

hoverNote: 21/10/2026 (HOVER-2, TEXT-1 batch 3): the header 'Book now' link, the listing titles (.heading-link) and the plain links (category names, tags) read one role at rest and on hover under some systems (Moxie, 5fd3), so hover and focus also underline; buttons, menu items and the logo keep their own states. The same underline is written on the link's inner words (span, strong, em, b, small, headings, p): the probe reads the cue on the element that holds the words, and an underline set on the link alone does not change that element's computed style. The typography page's 'Light' outline button (btn-outline-light, words forced black at 50%) reads one state at rest and on hover under Moxie dark, so it underlines as well.
